notes.title: 游戏永久降价公告
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are excited to announce that the price of this game will be permanently reduced from 48 RMB to 34 RMB! This is not a limited-time sale but a long-term adjustment made after careful consideration. Our goal is to make the game more accessible to a wider audience while continuing to support its development.

Reasons for the Price Adjustment
Making the Game More Accessible
Since its release, we’ve received overwhelming feedback from players, but we also noticed that some were hesitant due to the price. We believe great games should be enjoyed by as many people as possible, so we’ve decided to lower the barrier to entry.

Gratitude to Our Loyal Players
Over the years, your support has allowed us to keep improving the game. This price reduction is also a way to thank our early adopters, and we hope to continue delivering amazing experiences together.

Adapting to Market Trends & Staying Competitive
The gaming industry is evolving rapidly, and players have more choices than ever. By adjusting the price, we aim to ensure the game remains attractive while offering better value for both new and existing players.

Paving the Way for Future Content
We are still actively working on DLCs, updates, and optimizations. The price drop doesn’t mean the game’s value has decreased—instead, it’s a step toward building a stronger community for future content.

Special Thanks to Early Supporters
For players who purchased the game at the original price, we will soon offer exclusive rewards (such as special skins, DLC discounts, or in-game items) to show our appreciation.

Thank you all for your trust and support. Whether you’re a new or longtime player, you are the reason we keep moving forward!

Get the game now at the new price and start your adventure!

"The dream lives on — to illuminate the world with Chinese culture!"

notes.title: 8.1 Army Day limited time event is coming!
notes.content:
On the occasion of Army Day, "Bamboo Annals: Records of the Three Kingdoms" and "Bamboo Annals: Investiture of the Gods" have launched limited time promotional activities, bringing great value surprises to strategy game enthusiasts. During the event, the game price has been significantly reduced by 40%, and the current price is only 28.8 yuan! This is not only an excellent opportunity for discounts, but also a heartfelt reward for the player's support. Whether you are a loyal fan of strategy games or a new player trying chess games for the first time, this event is not to be missed.
Background of Army Day
Army Day is not only a tribute to history, but also inherits the "fighting spirit" and strategic concepts, providing us with rich strategic thinking.
Event Highlights
Great Value Discount: The prices of "Bamboo Annals: Records of the Three Kingdoms" and "Bamboo Annals: The Legend of Fengshen" have been significantly reduced from the original price of 48 yuan to 28.8 yuan, with a discount of up to 40%. This is one of the most attractive discounts since the game was launched, aimed at allowing more players to experience this strategy rich chess game.
**Rich experience: * * The game has won wide popularity with its unique chess gameplay and profound historical background of the Three Kingdoms. Players can freely set up formations, formulate strategies, and collaborate with various heroes to recreate the grandeur of the Three Kingdoms era.
**Limited time offer: * * This promotion is only valid from August 1st to August 6th and lasts for one week. Seizing this opportunity, you can experience high-quality chess games at the most favorable prices and experience the infinite fun of strategic battles.

Regarding the content included in the purchase:
Zhushu Chronicle: Records of the Three Kingdoms is a strategy game that deeply restores the history of the Three Kingdoms, integrating classic chess gameplay. You will transform into the wise strategist Sima Yi of the Three Kingdoms period, strategizing and winning for thousands of miles. In the game, there are not only rich historical plotlines, but also numerous classic battles, general development systems, and a variety of strategy choices.
"Bamboo Annals: Fengshen Zhuan" is a battle chess game adapted from the classic Chinese mythological work "Fengshen Yanyi", set in the late Shang Dynasty 3000-4000 years ago, adding a strong mythological color. This game is a part of the Bamboo Annals series, dedicated to spreading traditional Chinese cultural stories. Players will enter that ever-changing era, experiencing classic battles in mythology, meeting numerous mythological heroes, and experiencing the collision of ancient wisdom and courage. The game not only reproduces grand historical scenes, but also incorporates rich mythological elements, allowing every player to find their hero dreams in the game.
